boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a polished illustrated desktop/mobile concept board for Ashen Spire, an original dark fantasy tactical roguelike deckbuilder. This is visual polish inspiration, not an implemented screenshot.
Create one landscape presentation sheet, approximately 2400 x 1800, containing TWO clearly separated horizontal rows. Each row shows one feature as a large desktop 1440 x 900 viewport on the left and a portrait mobile 390 x 844 viewport on the right. FOUR UI frames total. Preserve each viewport's proportions; no phone or monitor hardware, no browser chrome, no OS bars. Small elegant feature captions outside frames. Generous gutters. Screens large, sharp, legible, richly illustrated. Board title at top, no commentary paragraphs.
Art direction grounded in the attached AshenSpire references: quiet grandeur, weathered pilgrim equipment, ruined gothic architecture, painterly realistic environments and full-body class figures. Dark umber/soot surfaces, warm ivory text, restrained oxidized brass edging, ember light, bone and leather. Region-specific light and fog; never muddy. Incised serif headings and clear modern body typography, tabular resource numbers. Precise linework, exquisitely painted objects, cinematic lighting with clean gameplay silhouettes.
UI polish: strong hierarchy, generous negative space, consistent shallow folding trays, fine dividers rather than nested boxes, restrained decoration. Primary available action uses a muted green accent; category selection brass/gold; focused Back/Close red. HP crimson, mana blue, stamina green, energy readable 3/3. Icons drawn in a consistent engraved style, no emoji. Show short readable English text only, avoid walls of microtext. One obvious primary action per frame. On mobile recompose intentionally for touch with 44px targets, readable type and bottom anchored actions; NEVER simply shrink the desktop. Keep critical information unobscured, no clipped buttons.
Reference screenshots describe actual game features and layout vocabulary; update their presentation ambitiously. Existing painting references establish world and material identity. No unrelated gameplay, no cash shop, no daily rewards, no MMO quest tracker. All data are illustrative.

Board title: ASHEN SPIRE — ARRIVAL & IDENTITY
Row captions: "Title, save slots & resume" and "Character creation".
ROW ONE: Ashen Spire title menu. Monumental broken spire through dawn ash and fog, isolated pilgrim silhouette. ASHEN SPIRE wordmark, Continue with a compact occupied-save receipt 'Reaver · Act I', Begin a Climb, compact secondary Run History, Compendium, Settings, Forsaken Together. Desktop a quiet menu offset against vast landscape with one small save list. Mobile vertically composed spire, clear stacked menu and one resume receipt.
ROW TWO: Character creation. Selected Reaver, richly painted armored figure with greatsword, distinct smaller Rogue, Starseer, Herald portraits. Desktop class choice left, full body figure center, folded configuration and starting attributes right. Picks Class, Kit, Keepsake, Sigil, Tint, Sprite; Standard / Assign points; Journey toggle Classic Climb / World Journey; clear final Begin Journey. Mobile selected figure top, four class tabs and ONE open starting-kit tray with folded rows below, fixed Begin Journey. Read choices back in a compact summary. No invented class names.

boards.title: Story & Consequence

boards.review: Opening prose, event copy and the Road Warden portrait are concept inventions; retain authored dialogue and consequences.

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a polished illustrated desktop/mobile concept board for Ashen Spire, an original dark fantasy tactical roguelike deckbuilder. This is visual polish inspiration, not an implemented screenshot.
Create one landscape presentation sheet, approximately 2400 x 1800, containing TWO clearly separated horizontal rows. Each row shows one feature as a large desktop 1440 x 900 viewport on the left and a portrait mobile 390 x 844 viewport on the right. FOUR UI frames total. Preserve each viewport's proportions; no phone or monitor hardware, no browser chrome, no OS bars. Small elegant feature captions outside frames. Generous gutters. Screens large, sharp, legible, richly illustrated. Board title at top, no commentary paragraphs.
Art direction grounded in the attached AshenSpire references: quiet grandeur, weathered pilgrim equipment, ruined gothic architecture, painterly realistic environments and full-body class figures. Dark umber/soot surfaces, warm ivory text, restrained oxidized brass edging, ember light, bone and leather. Region-specific light and fog; never muddy. Incised serif headings and clear modern body typography, tabular resource numbers. Precise linework, exquisitely painted objects, cinematic lighting with clean gameplay silhouettes.
UI polish: strong hierarchy, generous negative space, consistent shallow folding trays, fine dividers rather than nested boxes, restrained decoration. Primary available action uses a muted green accent; category selection brass/gold; focused Back/Close red. HP crimson, mana blue, stamina green, energy readable 3/3. Icons drawn in a consistent engraved style, no emoji. Show short readable English text only, avoid walls of microtext. One obvious primary action per frame. On mobile recompose intentionally for touch with 44px targets, readable type and bottom anchored actions; NEVER simply shrink the desktop. Keep critical information unobscured, no clipped buttons.
Reference screenshots describe actual game features and layout vocabulary; update their presentation ambitiously. Existing painting references establish world and material identity. No unrelated gameplay, no cash shop, no daily rewards, no MMO quest tracker. All data are illustrative.

Use attached board for visual-system consistency only, not screen content. Prioritize the feature's practical layout over repeating the title-menu structure. All names and data are illustrative. No invented monetization or live-service features.
Board title: ASHEN SPIRE — GROWTH & DISCOVERY
Row captions: "Class progression" and "Compendium".
ROW ONE: class progression view for Reaver. Desktop branching class skill tree laid out cleanly in a weathered folio, one available node selected with cost and effect, class level bar and distinct weapon skill training bars in adjacent folded pane. Mobile one branch at a time with touch-sized linked nodes and selected-node bottom sheet, level progress always visible. Label examples 'Level 4', '1 point available', 'Choose a node'. Top tier subtly indicates subclass choice without inventing named subclasses. Locked nodes have meaningful prerequisite label. Not a giant tangled MMO tree.
ROW TWO: Compendium of armaments. Desktop stable grid organized by weapon kind, unlocked objects beautifully lit, locked silhouettes show ONLY shape and rarity, no undiscovered names, stats or spoilers. Selected discovered Straight Sword expanded with illustration and concise description. Mobile two-column stable gallery, category selector, selected discovered-item detail on bottom. Show discovery count '8 / 24'. Ancient collector's folio with bone parchment and brass, distinguish silhouette forms, no live-store promotions.

boards.title: Company & Legacy
boards.polish: Make party readiness and connection states clear. Let results have atmosphere without burying the run record.
boards.review: The board combines lobby readiness with an in-run vote for coverage. Keep their actual flows separate and disable Start when readiness or reconnection prevents it. History names and values are illustrative.

Board title: ASHEN SPIRE — COMPANY & LEGACY
Row captions: "Forsaken Together co-op" and "Run results & history".
ROW ONE: LAN co-op 'Forsaken Together'. Desktop party lobby of up to four compact seat portraits Reaver, Rogue, Starseer, Herald, explicit host/join and readiness, local connection status and Start Together. Show small route-vote preview as ONE secondary strip with 2 votes on a fork, not social chat. Mobile seat list, ready control, concise reconnecting seat notice. Painted party camp in the background, no MMO guilds, no matchmaking currency.
ROW TWO: run result and history. Desktop final defeated Reaver at dawn overlooking broken spire, title 'The climb ends', compact run receipt with class, seed, acts reached and final encounter; unobtrusive route timeline and history list with selected record. Clear Begin Again action, inspect deck/relics. Mobile tall emotional character silhouette, concise result numbers, one expandable run record, Begin Again anchored bottom. Use dignity rather than huge YOU DIED gore text. Also show one small victory badge in historical record to indicate victory and defeat presentations. No unimplemented leaderboard.

boards.title: Preferences & Run Setup
boards.polish: Use readable, plain labels for settings. Keep optional configuration folded around the current decision.
boards.review: The Low/Medium/High/Epic art-quality labels are invented; preserve actual built-in/local-high-res choices. Draft card rules and availability must use canonical data.

Board title: ASHEN SPIRE — PREFERENCES & RUN SETUP
Row captions: "Settings, controls & profile" and "Custom run & draft".
ROW ONE: settings workspace that belongs in this fantasy game but is modern and exceptionally readable. Desktop categories General, Display, Audio, Controls, Accessibility, Advanced, Changelog; selected Display with text size, art quality and reduced-motion preview; Find settings search; changed-value dot and Reset; profile archive as folded secondary row. Mobile searchable categories, single Display section, 44px switch targets, high contrast/reduced motion and touch help visible, Back fixed. A small controls rebind receipt can sit as one folded row, no editor/dev settings dumped into player view. Plain labels over theatrical jargon.
ROW TWO: Custom Run configuration and starting draft. Desktop seed field, Classic Climb / World Journey selection, class summary, focused starting-card draft with three illustrated choices and clear Begin Custom Run; other options are folded. Mobile seed and journey controls above one large draft card with two compact alternatives, next-pick indicator and bottom Confirm Pick. Illustrative preview seed 'ASHEN-01'. Configurable challenge is optional, no difficulty sliders modifying unknown rules, no authoring tools. Keep a modern polished functional game menu with atmospheric spire backdrop.
